SHOUTCAST.App.Title: Audio Stream
SHOUTCAST.Control.Title: Audio Stream
SHOUTCAST.Message.Blocked: Your browser will not start audio until you interact with the page. Press Play to listen.
SHOUTCAST.Message.Failed: The stream could not be played. See the console (F12) for details.
SHOUTCAST.Message.MixedContent: This stream uses http but Foundry is served over https, so the browser blocks it. Serve the stream over https, or reach Foundry over http.
SHOUTCAST.Message.NoSignal: Nothing is being broadcast yet. Waiting for an audio source…
SHOUTCAST.Message.Unreachable: Still nothing after {attempts} attempts. That is normal if nobody is broadcasting yet — if you were expecting audio, check the stream server is running.
SHOUTCAST.Notify.NoUrl: Audio Stream URL is not configured. Ask your GM to set it in the SHOUTcast Player module settings.
SHOUTCAST.Settings.StreamUrl.Hint: Full URL of your Icecast/SHOUTcast audio stream, e.g. https://your.stream.host:8000/stream. Shared by everyone in the world. If Foundry is served over https, the stream must be too.
SHOUTCAST.Settings.StreamUrl.Name: Stream URL
SHOUTCAST.Settings.Volume.Hint: Volume level for the stream, saved per client.
SHOUTCAST.Settings.Volume.Name: Stream Volume
SHOUTCAST.Setup.GMHint: Go to Game Settings → Configure Settings → SHOUTcast Player to set the stream URL.
SHOUTCAST.Setup.NotConfigured: Audio Stream URL is not configured.
SHOUTCAST.Setup.PlayerHint: Ask your GM to set the stream URL in the SHOUTcast Player module settings.
